notes.title: Nocturnal Relics Patch 0.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
It's been a little bit more than a month since the release of Nocturnal Relics and I am very happy to see people enjoying the game :D This is the first patch for the game and these are the fixes and changes.


 Save and continue function have been implemented.
 The monster can now see the player. Before the monster could only hear. 
 The key will now return to it's original place if left alone for some time. This is to make sure that if it would fall through the floor it will come back. 
 
 The laser puzzle have been turned of since it made the game lag a lot and sometimes crash the game. 

 Small bug fixes


Next major update will probably contain the first puzzles of the new room.

Thank you for your support!
